propose.title: Headstash claim page: on-chain frontend (cw-headstash-frontend)
propose.description: Publishes the Headstash claim page on chain and points both headstash instances at it. 1) instantiate2 cw-headstash-frontend (code 106, checksum E72EEE9B90012CE42FED2C0ABD0B1FCC31B868168FA79D30D2F9D6FDD616CAC2) at terp1gnyl92dycyhwmw7sgmx0d6vt943vf6jtlulrmcs2j97s868wh2tqk7j7cu with admin and owner = this DAO, max_chunk_bytes 131072, salt 'headstash-frontend:v1', label 'headstash-frontend-v1'. 2) publish_manifest v1 (activate on completion), manifest sha256 cac6977abbd0f9b3281a8458e7fcde0b2ef1de96e8700aca5c1e7ceb906557e7, files: app.html 5023 B (gzip 2238, 1 chunk) sha256 2e1fd9ebed33c9ff919a7e107c0df1eb8b8dd9c656dae26484d22b02c6a0a69c; app.js 14638 B (gzip 5347, 1 chunk) sha256 0d62ead3e030245490116c791bb9fe1f36491826df31f29eaa29186b8061741d; crypto.js 10640 B (gzip 4316, 1 chunk) sha256 dd2b118ce02704b527eed4281eed5f217996f4a5232f325e2a886fd5bda75e4c; zk_headstash.js 10923 B (gzip 2754, 1 chunk) sha256 37a98d349275cb4a2c6e93f7278c4fc0c26c4120766d8f49add45448b0f8a964; zk_headstash_bg.wasm 2006266 B (gzip 664342, 6 chunks) sha256 51681559143fcdb411e00515a745bf880e13c23a77ed28f13a7640b71acbe1c8. 3) set_frontend_contract terp1gnyl92dycyhwmw7sgmx0d6vt943vf6jtlulrmcs2j97s868wh2tqk7j7cu on terpy (terp16ww6y3e7y63v98d9jzg0cft2u0ztx5kda0zvr0e90kwawh4hxweqhtvv7q), thioly (terp1yc4qtcwzv6g55vqrj95xq8anruwyy2ly4narcqs4a2hzgnu6rlrsa4s9r7). After execution the 10 chunks are uploaded permissionlessly (UploadChunk is sha-checked against this manifest); version 1 becomes current when the last chunk lands. Nothing is paid out and no funds move.
